title: 3 Interstellar Visitors Turned a Fluke Into a Pattern
hook: Three interstellar visitors mean the first one was not a fluke.
closing: A repeatable pattern gives scientists another chance to study material from other stars.
question: Will we ever catch one?

segments.say: Three interstellar visitors have been confirmed, turning a once-in-history surprise into a pattern.
The newest visitor reached 246,000 kilometers per hour, faster than either object before it.
Its nucleus measures 5.6 kilometers, giving scientists more material to study than the previous visitor.
